look_here_first: At a node, inspect the papery ocrea and its rim bristles. Compare mature achenes for a central hump on one face and flowers across multiple plants for heterostyly; P. pensylvanica is often homostylous. Identification remains provisional until both fruit and population flower characters are checked.
